notes: Iteration-1 ran on 2026-06-01: eval-1 (basic-request-with-blocked-dates) executed with-skill in a contained eval workspace. 7/7 assertions passed (100%). 52k tokens, 360s. Real WebSearch hit AFAS Live / 013 / TivoliVredenburg agendas. Baseline runs + remaining 3 evals deferred to a future benchmark run. See evals/workspace/iteration-1/eval-1-basic-request/ for raw outputs and per-assertion grading.

evals.prompt: Welke concerten zou ik leuk vinden de komende 3 maanden?
evals.expected_output: Skill loads event-radar.config.json, asks blocked dates + list types via AskUserQuestion, dispatches parallel research agents, writes <YYYY-MM-DD>-favs.md (+optional discovery/edm-genres) under docs/events/ with proper metadata header (generation date + period + blocked dates + location). Updates docs/events/README.md TOC. Writes back to config (distance_cache_km, venues.known_about) if new discoveries.
expectations: Skill reads event-radar.config.json before asking questions
AskUserQuestion is called at least once to gather blocked dates
Output filenames follow YYYY-MM-DD-<list-type>.md format (generation date in filename)
Each output file starts with a metadata blockquote containing 'Gegenereerd op', 'Zoekperiode', 'Uitgesloten datums', 'Locatie'
At least one research Agent (general-purpose) is dispatched
Output respects user's home_city + radii from config (defaults: Houten 100/500)
User-facing text is in Dutch (the user's default language preference)
Random sht / playlist taxonomy edge cases are not exposed in event output

evals.prompt: Find me concerts and festivals for the rest of 2026. I cannot make these dates: 2026-06-13 to 2026-06-22, 2026-07-22 to 2026-07-27. Focus on metal and hardstyle.
evals.expected_output: Skill respects explicit blocked dates without asking again. Genre filter limits agent dispatch to Metal/Rock + Hardstyle agents only (not all five). Output explicitly excludes events overlapping the blocked windows. Metadata header lists the blocked dates verbatim.
expectations: Skill does NOT re-ask for blocked dates (user provided them)
Blocked dates 2026-06-13 to 2026-06-22 and 2026-07-22 to 2026-07-27 appear in the metadata header verbatim
No events in the output fall within the blocked windows
Agent dispatch is limited to metal + hardstyle genre clusters (not rap/jazz/indie)
Output language matches the prompt's language (English, since the user prompted in English) — overrides config default
Output file naming uses today's date as YYYY-MM-DD prefix

evals.prompt: Doe een discovery-run, alleen kleinere venues zoals De Helling, Doornroosje, dB's, Paard. Voor de zomer van 2026.
evals.expected_output: Skill restricts venue_tier to small_underground, dispatches the Discovery agent only (not the main favs agent), output mentions adjacent-unknown artists with 'waarom je dit leuk vindt' explanations linked to known favs. No Ziggo Dome / AFAS Live / Ahoy entries.
expectations: venue_tier is set to 'small_underground' or equivalent
Output does NOT contain Ziggo Dome, AFAS Live, Ahoy, or other arena-tier venues
Output filename includes 'discovery' in the suffix
Each entry includes a 'why match' note linking to a user-known fav artist
At least one of De Helling / Doornroosje / dB's / Paard appears as a venue
Discovery agent (not favs agent) was dispatched

evals.prompt: Welke concerten zou ik leuk vinden vanaf Maastricht? Concertradius 75 km, festivals 300 km, voor herfst 2026.
evals.expected_output: Skill respects override: home_city = Maastricht, NOT Houten. Distance-table seed is no longer authoritative — skill recomputes distances or uses WebSearch. Output venues are filtered against Maastricht-based radius (so Amsterdam ~210 km is OUTSIDE concert radius). New venues like Muziekgieterij (Maastricht) are favored.
expectations: Skill respects home_city override (Maastricht, NOT Houten)
Output does NOT include Houten-based venue distances (e.g., 'Amsterdam (~35km)' would be wrong from Maastricht)
Amsterdam venues (>200km from Maastricht) are excluded from the concert list (concert radius 75km)
Local Maastricht-area venues (Muziekgieterij, AINSI) are included if events match
Search period = Herfst 2026 (September–November)
Skill writes back the new Maastricht-based distances to config's distance_cache_km
